'''Karrh''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Seyugi (culture)|Seyugi]] who lived several hundred years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He gathered warriors with potential in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and began training them in arts of stealth and assassination. These warriors became the first [[Seyugi Dervish]]es and began eliminating various threats to Seyugi people, eventually spreading across the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].
